plan_summary: Authenticate to Phone and Simple Note, identify Laura and her relevant incoming request, derive the requested movie-title list from the matching note, text it to Laura, re-query the conversation to verify the sent message, and complete the task.

steps.reasoning: The inspected contracts allow the supervisor profile and account-password records to be obtained, after which both apps can be logged into without exposing secrets.
steps.action_code:
supervisor_profile = apis.supervisor.show_profile()
account_password_records = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
def normalized_account_name(value):
    return "".join(ch for ch in value.casefold() if ch.isalnum())
phone_password_matches = [r["password"] for r in account_password_records if normalized_account_name(r["account_name"]) == "phone"]
simple_note_password_matches = [r["password"] for r in account_password_records if normalized_account_name(r["account_name"]) == "simplenote"]
assert len(phone_password_matches) == 1 and len(simple_note_password_matches) == 1
phone_session = apis.phone.login(username=supervisor_profile["phone_number"], password=phone_password_matches[0])
simple_note_session = apis.simple_note.login(username=supervisor_profile["email"], password=simple_note_password_matches[0])
phone_access_token = phone_session["access_token"]
simple_note_access_token = simple_note_session["access_token"]
verification_targets: Exactly one Phone credential and one Simple Note credential are resolved.
Phone and Simple Note access tokens are retained without printing credentials or tokens.

steps.reasoning: With Phone authenticated, all contact-search pages for the instruction-specified name can be read to obtain Laura candidates without assuming an ID or phone number.
steps.action_code:
contact_records = []
contact_page_index = 0
while True:
    contact_page = apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_access_token, query="Laura", page_index=contact_page_index, page_limit=20)
    contact_records.extend(contact_page)
    if len(contact_page) < 20:
        break
    contact_page_index += 1
laura_contacts = [r for r in contact_records if r["first_name"].strip().casefold() == "laura"]
assert laura_contacts
laura_phone_candidates = list(dict.fromkeys(r["phone_number"] for r in laura_contacts))
print([{"contact_id": r["contact_id"], "first_name": r["first_name"], "last_name": r["last_name"], "phone_number": r["phone_number"]} for r in laura_contacts])
verification_targets: Every page of Laura contact-search results is read.
At least one exact first-name Laura candidate is derived from public contact records.

note_summaries = []
note_page_index = 0
while True:
    note_page = apis.simple_note.search_notes(access_token=simple_note_access_token, query="", dont_reorder_pinned=True, page_index=note_page_index, page_limit=20)
    note_summaries.extend(note_page)
    if len(note_page) < 20:
        break
    note_page_index += 1
note_details = [apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=summary["note_id"], access_token=simple_note_access_token) for summary in note_summaries]
assert note_details
request_terms_for_notes = normalized_words(selected_request["message"])
common_terms = {"a", "an", "and", "are", "as", "at", "be", "can", "for", "from", "has", "have", "i", "in", "is", "it", "me", "my", "of", "on", "please", "send", "that", "the", "their", "them", "this", "to", "via", "with", "you", "your"}
